source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.0, data build 963, released 2026-09-30

data.summary:
As the battle begins, you can place 1 Teleport Homer token on the battlefield for this unit. If you do:

- whenever you use the **[Rapid Ingress](vsdata:ability/core.rapid-ingress)** Stratagem on this unit, you can use the token: that use costs 1CP less, but the unit has to be placed up to 3" from the token and more than 8" from every enemy unit, and the token is then removed
- if an enemy unit finishes a move up to 1" from the token, the token is removed

detail.trigger: owning unit selected for Rapid Ingress; token available
